result.reason: The file conforms to all three conventions. Subject framing: top-level describe names the module ('awards'), nested describes use 'when...' clauses, and each it states one observable outcome in plain language. One assertion per block: every it contains exactly one expect, using compound matchers (toMatchObject) for shapes. Functionality, not implementation: tests exercise the public pickWinners/createReview APIs, assert on returned values only, use the honest in-memory store, contain no spies, no mocking, no module-scope reach; test data is built fresh in beforeEach setup and suites do not depend on ordering or each other's state. The file is valid per the specification's path scope (tests/*.test.ts).
